description: Open times for one service at a business, from the business's live Lokuli calendar (the same one its page and apps use). Returns each open slot's start time (ISO) and a label in the business's time zone.

business.description: The business slug or lokuli.com/shop/... link

date.description: First day to check, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today)

service_id.description: The id of one of the business's services

staff_id.description: Optional team member id, to see only their times

name: get_available_times
title: Get open appointment times
